auszuege.business: NARI Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides power intelligence solutions in China and internationally. It offers intelligent control; smart power generation and transmission; smart substation; intelligent power distribution; smart electricity consumption; information and communications; comprehensive energy; intelligent operation and maintenance; industrial control; municipal environmental protection; industrial automation; rail transit; and water conservancy and water affairs solutions. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Nanjing, China. NARI Technology Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of NARI Group Corporation.
